initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity portrait iPhone screen concept for Cup Season's COMPETE tab, approximately 390 by 844 logical points, with no phone hardware, no surrounding desk, no poster title and no explanatory annotations. This is an illustrative design study, not a screenshot of a built app.
REFERENCE 1 is the existing app screenshot: inherit ONLY the green-black page ground, condensed board type for league names and figures, SF-style readable descriptions, hairlines and established bottom navigation. Replace its uniform oversized programme rows with the specified league-identity composition. Do not copy its enormous section heading or its repeated large score rules.
REFERENCE 2 is an existing local QA golf photograph; use that same photograph for the first league's image insert. The photograph illustrates image handling and is not evidence of this league's actual course. No other photography and NO invented faces.
The page uses #0F1A15 ground, #F1F4EF ink, #9BA69D secondary ink, #4A6155 rules. Keep all normal page surfaces neutral. League identity graphics may carry ONLY existing livery pairs: first Silver #8FA0BA and #B8C2CC, second Two Teams #5885DB and #C23544, third Evergreen #339561 and #C4394B. These are identity graphics, never performance or live-state colors. No gold, no orange action, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no 3D. No cactus/desert brand marks and no contour wallpaper. A photo's subject is allowed to be the supplied real golf scene.
There is a modest COMPETE masthead and a quiet 'Your seasons' label. Use around 20pt gutters. Text reflows, never overlaps an image or truncates a league name. A league's description is a short sentence in readable body type. Keep league figures compact; the people and league identity are the primary reading.
Carry these same illustrative records in this exact order:
1. THE DEW SWEEPERS. Supplied golf photograph. Description 'Early tee times. Long friendships.' Three small golfer marker discs, not faces, beside 'Tash, Dan +10'. Season footer 'BEFORE FIRST TEE' and 'Oct 11'. No points or rank because the season has not begun.
2. WHO'S THE BITCH? No photograph or uploaded logo: show a deliberately designed flat 'WTB' initial emblem in its two-color livery as a complete fallback. Description 'Two golfers. A season to settle it.' Golfer marker discs with 'You and Galen'. Compact season line 'WEEK 8 OF 15' and '2ND · 15 PTS'; one supporting sentence '4 back of Galen.' No trend chart.
3. THE FELLAS. An uploaded-logo example represented by a flat 'TF' letterform emblem in its existing two-color livery. Description 'Saturday golf, all season.' People line 'You, Jade +6'. Compact season line 'WEEK 3 OF 26' and '1ST · 25 PTS'. A third entry may continue beneath the fold if the composition requires it, but do not place meaningful controls behind the bottom bar.
Bottom navigation remains HOME, COMPETE selected, PLAY with its green #5FA271 accent, GOLFERS, YOU; five native-looking targets, around 44pt minimum. The Profile tab's icon and role remain unchanged. No hero-sized Create CTA competing with the leagues. Native safe areas and status bar retained.
COMPOSITION C — CLUB INDEX. A compact, highly considered league register: each league's identity line has a 52pt image or emblem, its league name in condensed board type, and a quiet chevron. The first is the supplied photo; the second is WTB fallback art; the third is TF uploaded-logo art. The full-width description is beneath the title. Beneath that, a clear people row of small golf marker discs and names. A compact bottom line carries season phase/week on the left and known rank/points on the right, with the gap sentence beneath only where supplied. A short two-color identity rule belongs close to each image, not a wide colored page background. Fit all THREE complete, distinct, comfortable entries above the tab bar. Avoid dense financial dashboard styling: the people, image and name lead, with score much quieter. This should feel like a golf society's well-designed membership and season list.
